title: Choose the visual world for Hire the Fire
question: The roll assigned Speed Post Tracking. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Speed Post Tracking
options.lineage: India Post Speed Post slips and consignment tracking
options.thesis: Every application is a consignment: booked, moved, stamped, delivered.
options.viewport: Postal-red rail with the recruiter jobs; stage tabs with counts; applicant table whose last column is a trail of dated postmarks.
options.risk: Turns twee if the postmark is used as ornament instead of only on real status moves.

raised.raise: Nothing disappears, it cancels: rejected and withdrawn applications stay in the trail, struck through.
Columns never move; rows reorder by when they last moved.
Every applicant carries a fixed nameplate: name, headline, skill match.
Each stage tab carries a bar sized by its share of applicants.

options.label: Reservation Chart
options.lineage: Indian Railways reservation charts pasted on coach doors
options.thesis: The pipeline read like a coach chart: every name with its status code, WL to CNF.
options.viewport: Railway-blue header; a dense chart table, each applicant with a short status code; counts per code above.
options.risk: Status codes add a decoding step for anyone who never booked a train.

options.label: High-Density Modules
options.thesis: Every number the recruiter needs, packed into ruled modules on one screen.
options.viewport: A mosaic of ruled modules: jobs, stage counts, new applicants, interviews today, each with a red tab.
options.case: Holds product clarity for daily triage; loses audience identification to the postal world.
options.risk: Tiny type tires recruiters over a full day and fails at 360 px for seekers.

options.label: Transit Line
options.thesis: Each job is a line; each stage a station; applicants ride toward Hired.
options.viewport: Midnight rail with jobs as coloured lines; the pipeline drawn as stations with head counts.
options.case: Pipeline-as-line reads instantly; the dark enamel ground loses audience identification for daytime desk work.
options.risk: A dark ground all day under office light, and line colours compete with status colours.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: Each application as a coupon that tears off stage by stage.
options.case: Overlaps the postal world and reads as travel, not hiring.
options.risk: Coupon chrome crowds a working table.

options.label: Split-Flap Board
options.thesis: Applicants as departures flipping between stages.
options.case: A costume of an instrument; flips slow down scanning.
options.kept: Columns never move; only rows change.
options.risk: Novelty wears off by day two.

options.label: Character Catalog
options.thesis: Applicants as a ranked roster of cards.
options.kept: A fixed nameplate on every entity.

options.label: Acetate Manual
options.thesis: Sections as coloured divider boards under acetate leaves.
options.viewport: Stepped tab rail down the edge.
options.case: A reading world, not a triage one.
options.kept: Tabs sized by their share of the whole.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A modern applicant-tracking dashboard, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Left nav, KPI row, kanban pipeline: the arrangement recruiters expect.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other ATS by design.
